semiconductor_relevance: High — Komatsu NTC specializes in equipment for slicing and grinding processes in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Komatsu NTC provides advanced wire saws and surface grinders for silicon wafer processing, focusing on high precision and efficiency. Their equipment is designed to enhance product yield and includes capabilities for slicing various materials, including quartz and other hard substances.
capabilities: Ultra-large wire saws for slicing materials exceeding 1000mm
Ultra-Precision Surface Grinder for high flatness on silicon wafers
Integrated software solutions for material inspection and processing
